mapper.select: SELECT * FROM announcements WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW()) AND ( -- 系统公告：所有用户可见 type = 'SYSTEM' -- 角色公告：目标角色包含用户角色 OR (type = 'ROLE' AND JSON_CONTAINS(target_roles, CONCAT('"', #{role}, '"'))) -- 个人通知：目标用户是当前用户 OR (type = 'PERSONAL' AND target_user_id = #{userId}) ) ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC
